cohort: 167 women who underwent CS at Sri Krishna Medical College and Hospital, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India, between May 2022 and April 2023.
finding: Groups 10 (previous caesarean section) and 5 (multiparous women with a single cephalic pregnancy at term who are induced or admitted in spontaneous labor) were the largest contributors to caesarean deliveries.
gest_age: Term (37-42 weeks) for 44.3% of participants; full gestational age not specified for all participants
